feature: Analysis tab lifecycle — PR C2, a reading that outlives an edit
note: The lifecycle states (Analysis tab handoff §2, 2i and the illegal line). Needs ANALYSIS_TAB_ENABLED=true and three decks the signed-in account owns, each put into its state by SQL before the run and put back after: ANALYSIS_STALE_DECK, a stored reading marked dirty (local-dev d…beef, `update deck_profiles set dirty = true`); ANALYSIS_SHORT_DECK, no reading and fewer than 99 cards (d…d5b1 with its Wastes cut by 10); ANALYSIS_SHORT_HELD_DECK, a stored reading over a list since cut short (d…c0b0 with its Wastes cut by 10). 2d, a failed re-read, has no fixture a server can be put into and is covered by analysis-panel.test.

rows.label: /decks/[id] Analysis — 2i, an edit since the reading: the banner above it, the date line says before your changes
